name: mac-dir-stat
one_liner: Treemap directory-size visualizer for macOS — find what's eating your disk and reclaim it

kill_criteria.statement: Two consecutive quarters with flat/declining GitHub stars AND no growth in weekly scan-completers (telemetry) → revert to maintain

north_star: GitHub stars — adoption proxy; ≥75 unlocks homebrew/cask notability. Guard metric: weekly scan-completers from telemetry.

decisions.rationale: Revive maintain→growing: v0.5.1 signed+notarized shipped, WinDirStat parity gains, analytics live, active star-growth push toward homebrew/cask notability.

notes: Desktop GUI (egui/eframe), not a CLI — record corrected 2026-06-18. Distributed via Homebrew cask + DMG. Flywheel SDK (Rust port of flywheel-client) wired in 2026-06-18: app_open + scan_completed key_action + conversion=freed-bytes (the aha) + error events post to the shared flywheel-core events table; ships dark until FLYWHEEL_SUPABASE_URL/ANON_KEY are baked at release. kpi_source=supabase, activation_event=conversion. Stage still 'maintain' on record but under active feature work (WinDirStat parity) + growth push per 2026-06-18 goal — maintain→growing revival is a pending human gate decision.
